newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-RAPID VIENNA HIT BOBY BRNO FOR SIX.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAPID VIENNA HIT BOBY BRNO FOR SIX.

text.p: Rapid Vienna thrashed Boby Brno of the Czech Republic 6-1 in the UEFA Cup second preliminary round, first leg on Tuesday.
Samuel Ipoua opened the scoring for the Austrians in the 36th minute after a pass from former Boby Brno striker Rene Wagner.
Wagner was replaced by Peter Stoeger shortly afterwards due to recurring left knee problems and the substitute made it 2-0 shortly before the break.
Richard Dostalek hit Boby Brno's only goal in the 53rd minute for 2-1 before Ipoua restored the two-goal cushion nine minutes later.
Christian Prosenik, Christian Stumpf and Stoeger completed the tally in the closing minutes.
